label: CCC 199-200: 'I believe in God' is the first and most fundamental affirmation of the creed, and…
paraphrase: CCC 199-200: 'I believe in God' is the first and most fundamental affirmation of the creed, and the faithful first profess their belief in God; the confession of God's oneness, with which the Niceno-Constantinopolitan Creed begins, is inseparable from the profession of God's existence.
